reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Rejected on review: it breaks the calendar
summary: The patch passes input mode as false to vanilla-calendar-pro. That removes the Tab trap, but after a click the calendar is no longer visible (0 of 35 days visible, against 35 before the patch).
caveats: The frozen pointer path never opened the calendar, so the browser gate could not see this.
A stricter case, bootstrap6-datepicker-tab-trap-with-picker, adds a pointer guard for it; the patch is replayed there without inference.
